rows.text: Mizzix reduces only GENERIC costs, one per experience counter, and never the coloured pips. At four experience Reiterate with buyback costs RR, but Crackle with Power still costs 3X minus four plus RR: the discount comes off the total, not off each X. Count your coloured mana, not your total, before you start a chain.
A Goblin storm deck by zzwang. Bracket 3: the three Game Changers are Lion's Eye Diamond, Mystical Tutor and Underworld Breach. No mass land denial.

rows.name: Mizzix of the Izmagnus
rows.text: casting an instant or sorcery with mana value greater than your experience gives another counter, and each counter makes them one cheaper. Climb it with a 1, then 2, then 3, then 4-drop; after that most of the deck costs only its pips.

rows.name: Goblin Electromancer
rows.text: another one-generic discount for the turns Mizzix is not out, and a second Goblin for the deck.

rows.name: Big Score
rows.text: costs R at three experience: two cards and two Treasures for one red.

rows.name: Mizzix of the Izmagnus + Reiterate
rows.text: the core engine. At four experience, Reiterate with buyback costs RR and comes back to hand every time.

rows.name: Reiterate + Desperate Ritual
rows.text: cast the ritual, hold it on the stack, buy back Reiterate for RR copying it: RRR back, net +R and +1 storm each lap. Stop, resolve the original, then cast the finisher.

rows.name: Reiterate + Pyretic Ritual
rows.text: the same loop with the second ritual.

rows.name: Reiterate + Seething Song
rows.text: net +3 red and +1 storm per lap.

rows.name: Reiterate + Mana Geyser
rows.text: three tapped opposing lands make it mana-positive at four experience. Without Mizzix, six tapped lands sustain it and seven profit, but you need eleven mana to start.

rows.name: Reiterate + Turnabout
rows.text: copy Turnabout to untap your lands each lap. Three lands are enough once the first UU and RR are paid.

rows.name: Crackle with Power
rows.text: the finish: at X=8 it deals 40 to each opponent. With experience its 24 generic shrinks, the RR does not.

rows.name: Lightning Bolt
rows.text: the backup finish: buy back Reiterate on Bolt as many times as you have mana.

rows.name: Archmage Emeritus
rows.text: draws on every cast and copy and the draw is mandatory. Before an unbounded Reiterate loop, bounce it with Snap or Into the Roil, or you deck yourself.

rows.name: Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Brain Freeze
rows.text: start with Breach out, an empty hand, and LED, Freeze and six other cards in the graveyard. Escape LED for free, crack it for UUU, escape Freeze for 1U: each lap is two casts, a floating U and six cards exiled. Aim the early Freezes at yourself to fill the graveyard, but keep seven cards in your library. Once storm is high enough, aim every copy at the opponents until their libraries are empty, crack the last LED for red and escape Wheel of Fortune: they draw from empty libraries and lose. Mizzix is not needed. Crackle is not the finish here: X=8 costs 26 mana, far more than the laps make.

rows.name: Lion's Eye Diamond
rows.text: also a free ritual on the Reiterate turn: crack it with the chain spell on the stack after your hand is empty.

rows.name: Brain Freeze
rows.text: on its own, a mill finish once storm is high: three cards per copy.

rows.name: Stroke of Genius
rows.text: with unlimited mana, aim it at an opponent and Reiterate copies it for the others.

rows.name: Past in Flames
rows.text: flashback all the rituals and cantrips for a second lap; also cheaper with experience.

rows.name: Mizzix's Mastery
rows.text: overloaded at high experience: cast every instant and sorcery in your graveyard for free.

rows.name: Mystical Tutor
rows.text: Reiterate, Brain Freeze or the missing ritual. It cannot find Underworld Breach, an enchantment: Muddle the Mixture does that.

rows.name: Personal Tutor
rows.text: a sorcery to the top: Mana Geyser, Past in Flames, Mizzix's Mastery or Crackle with Power.

rows.name: Firemind's Foresight
rows.text: Reiterate, Desperate Ritual and Lightning Bolt in one card: a whole kill.

rows.name: Muddle the Mixture
rows.text: transmute for Underworld Breach or Brain Freeze; the transmute cost is not discounted.

rows.name: Spellseeker
rows.text: finds Brain Freeze, Desperate Ritual or Mystical Tutor.

rows.name: Merchant Scroll
rows.text: finds a blue instant: Mystical Tutor (which then finds Reiterate), Muddle the Mixture or a counterspell for the kill turn.

rows.name: Solve the Equation
rows.text: any instant or sorcery: Reiterate, Turnabout or Crackle with Power.

rows.name: Tezzeret's Gambit
rows.text: draw two and proliferate experience.

rows.name: Frantic Search
rows.text: free after a discount; untaps three lands.

rows.name: Snap
rows.text: untaps two lands and returns Archmage Emeritus before a loop.

rows.name: High Tide
rows.text: doubles Islands for the chain turn, and Turnabout or Frantic Search untaps them for more.

rows.name: Windfall
rows.text: a full refill for the chain turn, and cheap once Mizzix has a few counters.

rows.name: Wheel of Fortune
rows.text: the second wheel.

rows.name: Dig Through Time
rows.text: delve makes it two blue late.

rows.name: Treasure Cruise
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: early draw; let it go once the chain starts.

rows.name: Storm-Kiln Artist
rows.text: a Treasure per instant or sorcery cast or copied: Reiterate loops make Treasures too.

rows.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
rows.text: a red for every spell, which pays the RR on Reiterate.

cards.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: makes your spells uncounterable for the chain turn.

rows.name: Pact of Negation
rows.text: free on the turn you win.

rows.name: Force of Negation
rows.text: free on an opponent's turn.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: counter, and next turn's mana funds the chain.

rows.name: Flusterstorm
rows.text: wins counter wars during the chain.

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: one blue for a counterspell or a sweeper.

rows.name: Into the Flood Maw
rows.text: one blue to bounce a Rule of Law or Damping Sphere that stops the engine.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free with Mizzix out.
Keep lands of both colours, a cantrip and one ramp piece. Mizzix on turn 3 or 4, then climb experience with a 2-, 3- and 4-drop instant or sorcery on successive turns.
The Reiterate and Breach loops are played from turn 6 by table agreement. Before then, build experience, sculpt the hand and hold protection.
On the kill turn: Squelcher or a free counter up first, rituals into Reiterate, Archmage Emeritus out of the way, then Crackle with Power.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: early speed into Mizzix.

rows.name: Lotus Petal
rows.text: the last coloured mana on the chain turn.

rows.name: Simian Spirit Guide
rows.text: a free red for Reiterate.
